does_not_amend: any other clause of O3_CFORK_RECALL_AMENDMENT.json or O3_PROTOCOL_FROZEN.json

false_claim.text: the C3 backward trace runs within a carry phase, so the first clause (blue is carrying) holds throughout
false_claim.also_in_commit_message: ce7949f claimed recall was arguable from the frozen definitions because the C3 backward trace runs inside a carry phase

what_is_actually_true: R1 still guarantees n_legal_team_responses >= 2 at a qualified fork
nothing in the C3 contract constrains the T_trace=40 backward trace to remain inside a carry phase
the trace runs upstream of the pressure onset and routinely reaches before pickup
a qualified commitment fork can therefore sit with blue_carrying=False
correction.consequence_for_C_fork: The frozen carry-phase precursor structurally excludes pre-pickup forks. That is a scope limitation of the O3 experiment under this freeze, not a licence to retune the predicate after measuring coverage.
correction.consequence_for_C3: Pre-pickup forks are a broadening of the fork concept (approach commitment can be strategically relevant), not a defect in the Stage-4 controllability screen.

audit_result_that_motivated_this_erratum.classification: EVALUATION-ONLY DIAGNOSTIC — run once — may not retune the predicate

finding_1.summary: Most misses are pre-pickup forks reachable by the C3 backward trace before possession.
finding_1.support: 44 of 47 after-only cases have fork_step <= 40; CUDA spot-checks show carrying=0 at those fork steps (e.g. ev9810009, ev9810007).

finding_2_dissolved.summary: The residual 'impossible miss' was a CPU/CUDA trajectory mismatch, not an audit fault.
finding_2_dissolved.detail: Same seed on CPU vs CUDA diverges by step 0 (n_legal 6 vs 4); by step 12 CPU had carrying=1/n_legal=4 while CUDA (audit + Stage-4) had carrying=0/n_legal=2. Audit and labels are CUDA-aligned; the CPU check measured a different episode.

interpretation_now_frozen.claim_scope: O3 tests whether a distinct policy can emerge for the ~70% of confirmed commitment opportunities that occur after pickup (carry-phase forks).
interpretation_now_frozen.coverage_vs_threshold: 0.7006 >= 0.50 → a negative O3 result remains interpretable under the preregistered rule
interpretation_now_frozen.bound: interpretability is bounded to carry-phase specialization; pre-pickup specialization is unresolved and is not tested by this freeze
interpretation_now_frozen.not_a_predicate_edit: This freezes how results may be read. It does not change C_fork, the onset rule, or the 0.50 threshold.

operational_rule_going_forward.rule: CPU and CUDA replays are not interchangeable in this environment.
operational_rule_going_forward.requirement: Any future diagnostic that checks an artifact must run on the same device that produced that artifact.
operational_rule_going_forward.why_recorded: The false Finding-2 alarm came from a cross-device spot-check; the same mistake would corrupt a real result if unnoticed.

why_this_erratum_is_not_supervision_thro.motivation: Correct a false argument about frozen definitions after the evaluation-only audit measured coverage. The amendment forbade retuning the predicate from that number; this document obeys that rule and only corrects the argument and the claim scope.
why_this_erratum_is_not_supervision_thro.forbidden_alternative_explicitly_rejecte: Editing C_fork after seeing coverage 0.7006, or iterating audit-and-adjust.
